behaviorPreserved: Five preview identities, existing legacy row placement, linked section cells and layout ranges
Review-only status, exact production approval and recovery requirements
scope.publicFixtureRule: Use explicit synthetic student, grade, school and group values. Never copy local canonical identities into public examples or seed synthetic identities into local canonical data.
scope.productionRule: The layout's sample roster is not production authority. Any actual roster must be obtained from the separately verified local source and reviewed for the exact approved batch.

residualTrackedCandidates.meaning: These files matched one or more identities from the previously embedded student roster. This is a bounded exposure inventory, not a complete privacy or credential audit. Values are intentionally omitted.
potentialDataClasses: Student names and stable LMS identifiers
Linked school, grade, class schedule, attendance and assessment fixture data

unassessed: Protected config/ and data/ contents, credentials and unrelated personal records
Repository history, remote branches, pull requests, build artifacts, caches and copies
remediationBoundary: A local working-tree edit does not remove data from a published branch, earlier commits, forks or downloaded copies.
Operational assertions and archival evidence need a coordinated, reviewed migration rather than blind replacement or deletion.
Repository visibility changes, publication, history rewriting and destructive remediation require separate explicit authorization.
